annotations.title: List the files on a Flowershow site

description: List the files currently on one of the signed-in user's Flowershow sites: each path, its size in bytes and when it last changed. Use it before updating a site in a new conversation, to see which pages exist, pick the right paths to update or delete, and avoid duplicating a page under a new name. Get siteId from list-sites. Returns up to 1000 paths; for bigger sites, pass folder to list one folder at a time. If the user is not signed in yet, calling it asks them to sign in to Flowershow first.

folder.description: Only list files in this folder (and its subfolders), e.g. "blog"

siteId.description: siteId of the site, from list-sites
